text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-tail-latency SLO breached (p99 2.5s > 1.0s) for region-us-west-2. Triggered at 2026-03-15 02:12 UTC. Possible KV cache pressure on shards s-12,s-13. Paging oncall.
Samir Cole: on it. seeing large spike in evictions and prefill queue length on s-12 in the last 8m. streaming stalls correlate with eviction spikes.
Samir Cole: quick numbers: overall error-rate up ~1.8%, p95 ~420ms (ok), p99 ~2.5s (bad), dropped streaming frames ~0.6% across affected shards.
Ashwin Patel: pinging infra trace dashboard now, also checking if any rollout landed around 02:00.
Maya Rao: I can open the KV metrics dashboard — prefill vs decode ratio looks skewed: prefill throughput x3 decode throughput on s-12 -> prefill is starving decode path causing lots of fragment evictions.
Elena Gomez: FYI customer ops — Jordan let me know which customers are seeing errors?
Jordan (Customer Success): we have 3 flagged customers (acme-inc, chatly, docsprint). ACME reports stalled streaming for long completions, some reconnects. I'll message them with a brief ack and ETA.
Samir Cole: mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefill for s-12 to rebalance; 2) increase cache slab allocation for s-12 temporarily; 3) route new streaming requests for non-SLA customers to region-us-east-1 fallback.
Ashwin Patel: commands ready. to throttle prefill run:
```
rictl cache set-priority --shard s-12 --prefill-weight 0.3
```
To bump slab (emergency):
```
rictl cache adjust-slab --shard s-12 --size 24Gi --reason "emergency-eviction-mitigation"
```
I'll push both as quick fixes.
Samir Cole: applying prefill throttle now.
Samir Cole: `rictl cache set-priority --shard s-12 --prefill-weight 0.3` -> accepted, prefill q length dropping.
Maya Rao: I'm enabling temporary routing change for best-effort tenants:
```
rictl routing add-policy --name streaming-fallback --match "tenant.tier==best-effort" --dst region-us-east-1 --ttl 10m
```
Maya Rao: routing rule applied. traffic shifted ~12% away from us-west-2.
Ashwin Patel: slab adjust in progress: `rictl cache adjust-slab --shard s-12 --size 24Gi` -> succeeded. eviction rate dropping.
Elena Gomez: metrics update?
Samir Cole: p99 down from 2.5s -> ~780ms within 5m of mitigations. dropped frames reduced to 0.1%. Errors for flagged customers reduced, Jordan pls confirm.
Jordan (Customer Success): ACME confirms streams resumed and latency improved. they appreciate the quick response.
Samir Cole: handing off to Ashwin for follow-ups & post-incident: I'll stay available for 30m. Ashwin — can you own the RCA and long-term remediation?
Ashwin Patel: taking handoff. TODOs in thread: 1) full heap/kv allocator profile on s-12/s-13 (collect gc/fragmentation traces), 2) add an alert for prefill:decode imbalance ratio > 2.0, 3) evaluate scheduler that prioritizes decode over prefill for streaming routes, 4) schedule capacity increase or more even slab distribution across shards.
Maya Rao: add a temporary synthetic test to catch streaming stalls in staging using long streaming completions.
Elena Gomez: I'll draft customer communications summarizing impact + mitigation.
Samir Cole: note for postmortem: root likely cache fragmentation + an unbalanced prefill config (recent config bump for prefill weight rolled to s-12 at 01:55). we need change-control audit.
Ashwin Patel: logging capture: saved kv-metrics dump -> s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4977770000/kv-metrics.tar.gz. also enabling extended agent logs for 1h.
Jordan (Customer Success): sharing ACME's short quote: "streams resumed, thanks" — will include in comms.
Maya Rao: good handoff. Ashwin, ping me when the RCA draft is ready, I'll add operational mitigations to playbook.
Ashwin Patel: acknowledged — creating incident document and linking todos. assigning postmortem owner: Ashwin + Maya. leaving follow-up items in ops tracker.
Incident Bot: Handoff recorded: oncall from Samir to Ashwin at 02:24 UTC.
Samir Cole: signing off from active triage, monitoring passively.
Ashwin Patel: last note before we close thread: schedule a config rollback for the prefill bump for s-12 if we can't find durable fix in 72h.
Maya Rao: thanks team. I'll update the channel with postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
